tasks.title: Routes wait when the destination has outflow; block only when there is none
tasks.window: Gameplay lane, after T79; with T69
tasks.brief: Owner direction 2026-10-27. A route must not break just because supply exceeds demand (for example the route delivers 10 and the destination sells 5). Rule: when the destination storage is full or has less room than the load, a route that has OUTFLOW at the destination for that commodity WAITS: it moves only what fits this cycle (partial load, no all-or-nothing), never turns red and raises no notification; status text 'Waiting for room.' in a neutral colour. Outflow = an enabled local Sell order for that commodity at the destination, or an outgoing route from that storage for that commodity. Only when the destination is full and there is NO outflow does the route become BLOCKED (red, one notification, stops) because nothing will ever make room; it resumes by itself when an outflow appears or the storage drains. An empty source still stalls. Update the cash forecast so a waiting route shows the reduced amount it really moves. Handoff: handoffs/gameplay-programmer/<date>-T70.json.
